Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send Your blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيْ أَذْهَبَ اللَّيْلَ مُظْلِمًا بِقُدْرَتِهِ
Translation: All praise is for Allah who removed the darkness of night by His power
And brought the day with light by His mercy
And clothed me in its brightness while I am in His blessing

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ فَكَمَا أَبْقَيْتَنِيْ لَهُ فَأَبْقِنِيْ لِأَمْثَالِهِ
Translation: O Allah, as You have kept me alive for this day, keep me alive for similar days

Arabic text: وَصَلِّ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: And send blessings upon Prophet Muhammad and his family
And do not afflict me in this day or other days
From the nights and the days
By committing forbidden acts
And earning sins
And grant me its goodness
And the goodness that is in it
And the goodness that comes after it
And turn away from me its evil
And the evil that is in it
And the evil that comes after it

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي بِذِمَّةِ الْإِسْلاَمِ أَتَوَسَّلُ إِلَيْكَ
Translation: O Allah, I seek means to You through the covenant of Islam
And by the sanctity of the Quran I rely upon You
And through Muhammad, the Chosen One
May Allah's blessings be upon him and his family
I seek intercession with You
So recognize, O Allah, my covenant
By which I hope for the fulfillment of my needs
O Most Merciful of the merciful ones

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ اقْضِ لِيْ فِيْ الْخَمِيْسِ خَمْسًا
Translation: O Allah, fulfill for me on Thursday five things
For which only Your generosity is sufficient
And only Your favors can encompass
Safety by which I can be strengthened in Your obedience
And worship by which I deserve Your abundant reward

Arabic text: وَسَعَةً فِيْ الْحَالِ مِنَ الرِّزْقِ الْحَلَالِ
Translation: And abundance in the state of lawful sustenance

Arabic text: وَأَن تُؤْمِنَنِيْ فِيْ مَوَاقِفِ الْخَوْفِ بِأَمْنِكَ
Translation: And that You grant me security in times of fear through Your protection

Arabic text: وَتَجْعَلَنِيْ مِنْ طَوَارِقِ الْهُمُومِ وَالْغُمُومِ فِيْ حِصْنِكَ
Translation: And place me in Your fortress from the onslaughts of worries and sorrows

Arabic text: وَ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: And send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
And make my seeking means through him an intercessor
On the Day of Resurrection, beneficial
Indeed, You are the Most Merciful of the merciful ones
